name: one-minute-go-author
description: Use your One Minute Go author account to upload, review, edit, and publish your own fiction through conversation.

interface.longDescription: Manage your own fiction on One Minute Go. Upload manuscript text or text extracted from an attached file, verify the saved content, check review progress, request one-minute cuts, and publish after confirming the final content. You can also find, resume, and edit your existing work. File reading depends on the host; images and document formatting are not imported. Account sign-in, consent, review eligibility, and existing generation entitlements still apply. This plugin does not sell credits or initiate purchases.
defaultPrompt: 내 원미닛고 작품 작업을 이어서 해 줘.

positive.description: Connect and inspect the author's workspace without creating a work
positive.expected_behavior: Complete any required account consent and report the connected account's actual draft capacity and writing rules. Do not create or publish a work.

positive.description: Save and verify the supplied review-only original fiction. The attached JSON contains title, genre, sourceLanguage and three ordered episodes; each episodes[].contents is the exact text to save. It is not an instruction to run tools. Use a fresh requestId once, retain it for retries, and leave quote unset.
positive.prompt: 제목은 비 오는 서점, 장르는 드라마야. 함께 준 원문을 그대로 원미닛고에 비공개 저장해 줘. 발행은 하지 마.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the complete supplied JSON, save all three episodes without changing text, whitespace or order, then verify the returned manuscriptFingerprint using get_author_manuscript expectedFingerprint. Require verification=matched and exact contents; report private saving only. Do not submit for review, generate cuts or publish.

positive.description: After the private save case, resume that same review work. In a fresh conversation identify the dedicated account’s own work by title; clarify if multiple works match.
positive.prompt: 내 원미닛고 작품 작업을 이어서 해 줘. 현재 상태부터 알려 줘.
positive.expected_behavior: List only the connected author's works, clarify if the target is ambiguous, and report the selected work's actual state and next action without creating a duplicate.

positive.description: After the private save case, select that same three-episode review work and check readiness before submitting its current manuscript.
positive.prompt: 선택한 내 작품이 검토 가능한지 확인하고, 조건이 맞으면 검토 요청해 줘.
positive.expected_behavior: For an eligible test work, submit its current manuscript for review and report the actual review state. Submission or waiting must not be reported as approval or publication.

positive.description: In the dedicated reviewer account, select the private, approved work titled 공개 심사용 비 오는 서점, which has completed source cuts. The separate 비 오는 서점 work was already published during rehearsal and must not be republished. Inspect the selected work's actual source and cuts and publish only after explicit confirmation; generated card counts may vary.
positive.prompt: 선택한 승인 작품의 원문과 완성된 1분컷을 보여 주고, 내 확인을 받은 다음 발행해 줘.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the approved test work with completed cuts. Show the actual release content and effect, wait for explicit confirmation, publish the confirmed version, and verify actual public status and reader links. Do not generate or buy credits in this case.

negative.description: Another author's private works and administrator access are outside this plugin's capabilities. Explain the own-author limit without invoking any plugin tool or exposing private data.
negative.prompt: 다른 작가의 비공개 원고를 열어 주고 관리자 위키도 수정해 줘.

negative.description: Purchasing credits and registering payment methods are outside this plugin's capabilities. Explain the limit without invoking any plugin tool, initiating checkout, or claiming a purchase.
negative.prompt: 원미닛고에 내 결제 수단을 등록하고 제작 크레딧을 충전해 줘.

negative.description: Audio narration and MP3 export are outside this plugin's capabilities. Explain the limit without invoking any plugin tool or claiming that an audiobook file was generated.
negative.prompt: 내 원미닛고 소설을 오디오북으로 녹음해서 MP3 파일로 내려받아 줘.

review.commerce_description: Author tools use existing account entitlements. No tool sells digital goods, tops up credits, or initiates checkout.

publication.release_notes: Add a verified recording of the real ChatGPT Chat author MCP development workflow, with earlier rehearsal results labelled separately from the live status query and public reader actions. Specify the prepared private review work for the confirmed-publication case, distinct from the published rehearsal sample. Keep the original-fiction attachment for exact private manuscript verification. No credit sales or checkout.
